module: WebSocket server backend of lua-websockets for the lua-ev event loop ('ev' module, not provided by the game). listen accepts connections asynchronously, performs the handshake, then creates a callback-driven client object (on_message, on_close, on_error).
notes: Requires the 'ev' module (lua-ev); without it the require fails. Probably not used in the game (inferred from code).
Several error messages are displayed with print() rather than passed up to the callback.

listen.desc: Starts an asynchronous WebSocket server on the ev loop. Raises an error if the bind fails.

opts.desc: port (default 80), interface (default '*'), loop (default ev.Loop.default), protocols (subprotocol -> function(client)), default (function(client)). protocols or default is required.

returns.desc: Server object: on_error(self, f), sock() (listening socket), close(keep_clients).

client.desc: Client object passed to the handler (state 'OPEN'). Callbacks are set with the on_* methods.

broadcast.desc: Sends to all the clients of the same subprotocol.

close.desc: Closes the connection cleanly (CLOSE frame) with an expiry timeout.

start.desc: Starts asynchronous reading of the messages; called by listen after the handler is called.
